entities.title: Native-first examples
entities.summary: One test class per .NET type (DateOnlyTests, DateTimeOffsetTests, TimeZoneInfoTests, …), in folders that mirror .NET's namespaces: what .NET does for each task, compared with UTV.
entities.purpose: Organized by the System namespace, class and method. Where .NET and UTV agree, the expected value is computed with UTV; where they differ, it is a literal and the Compared with: sentence says what UTV does. Globalization/ and Text/Json/ hold the System.Globalization and System.Text.Json classes.
boundaries: TimeZoneInfoTests reads the host's tz database, as its class comment says; DateTimeOffsetTests and DateTimeTests each read the clock once, on purpose, with a remark saying why the outcome cannot depend on it.
